title: TWC Ltd - Senior IT Programme Manager | Cyber Security & Cloud Transformation Leader
content: Executive profile of SC Cleared Senior IT Programme Manager delivering large-scale cyber security, cloud transformation and enterprise infrastructure programmes across NHS England, Defence and international enterprises. Specialist in cyber security uplift, cloud adoption, enterprise infrastructure modernisation and workplace transformation. Delivered programmes impacting over 120,000 users across Defence, NHS England, financial services and global law firms. Key achievements include delivery of a £40M cyber security uplift programme for NHS England improving CAF maturity, global Windows 10 and Windows 11 transformation for 126,000 devices across 42 countries, and Azure and AWS cloud adoption programmes improving resilience and reducing operational cost by 18%. Consulting expertise includes cyber security programmes covering CAF, IAM, MFA, CyberArk, Splunk and identity security platforms; cloud transformation using Azure, AWS, Entra, Intune and enterprise cloud adoption frameworks; workplace modernisation including Windows 10 and Windows 11 migration, Teams Rooms and global device estate transformation; programme governance including PMO leadership, financial governance, RAID management and delivery assurance in ISO regulated environments using ITIL frameworks; service transition and BAU readiness including operational readiness, onboarding for 25,000 users, Salesforce BAU integration, documentation governance and support alignment; and pre-sales including solution design, tender responses and commercial modelling. Consulting services include cyber security programme leadership, cloud transformation programmes, workplace modernisation, and programme governance and PMO. Programme case studies include NHS England cyber security uplift with MFA, CyberArk, Splunk, Azure security controls and secure backup infrastructure; global workplace transformation for up to 126,000 devices; and enterprise cloud deployments delivering improved scalability, resilience and operational performance. Certifications include APM PMQ, PRINCE2 Practitioner, PRINCE2 Agile, P3O Practitioner, ITIL, NIST Cyber Framework, Six Sigma Green Belt, MCSE and ServiceNow IT Leadership. Industry contribution includes STEM Ambassador, APM mentor, research advisor, career fair speaker, volunteer interview mentor and UK Employee Forum representative at Computacenter. Contact details include email, phone and LinkedIn.
